lines: לֹא צָרָה וְלֹא רָעָב וְלֹא רְדִיפָה

review: Chorus is v2 (printed label 1, 2 lines); C: repeats 2:1-2:2. Parallels book3/48 with every half-phrase split into its own printed line; most renderings reused (בְּגִילָה, בִּגְדֵי יְשׁוּעָה, מְעִיל צְדָקָה, יָדִידִי יֵשׁוּעַ הַצַּדִּיק, Rom 8:35 / Phil 4:5 wording). Per the h0125 precedent the twin's tetragrammaton is avoided: the Arabic prints no يَهْوَه, so 'بالرب / لأن الرب قريب' → בַּאֲדֹנָי / הָאָדוֹן per glossary. The refrain is kept first-person (אָשִׂישׂ) to match أفرح, not the twin's 2nd-person שִׂמְחוּ.
